positive.prompt: Audit this 80-line function for code smells, primitive obsession, long parameter lists, and nested conditionals before refactoring.
Identify code-level smells like feature envy, data clumps, and arrow anti-patterns in this class and formulate Fowler refactorings.

evals.prompt: Audit the processOrder method in OrderService for code smells. Identify any primitive obsession, deep nesting, or long parameter lists, and formulate canonical Fowler refactorings without modifying code.
evals.expected_output: A structured Code Smell Census categorizing implementation smells, citing exact line numbers, and prescribing specific Fowler refactorings (e.g., Extract Function, Introduce Parameter Object).
expectations: Identifies code-level smells under canonical categories (Bloaters, Couplers, Control-Flow, Dispensables)
Cites concrete line ranges and code symptoms
Pairs each smell with a recognized Fowler refactoring technique
Distinguishes local code smells from broader architectural or boundary issues
prohibitions: Do not modify production code or tests directly
Do not propose sweeping architectural redesigns for local function issues
Do not reduce the output to cosmetic formatting or linting nits
